## Executive Summary
Vo Nguyen Dang Khoa (Khoa Vo) is a hybrid Creative Leader and Systems/Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. With 9+ years of brand and creative leadership (notably leading eCommerce design at Procter & Gamble and AI video pipelines at Phibious) paired with 2+ years of intensive production software engineering (18+ deployed applications in Next.js, Go, Rust, and Synology NAS systems), Khoa bridges the gap between high-level creative vision and low-level technical execution.

## Key Software Projects & Deployments

### 1. KV-TrimUI Handheld OS & 18-App Ecosystem (`trimui.vndns.net`)
- **Role:** Creator & Lead Systems Architect
- **Tech:** Rust 1.85+ (`/dev/fb0` 60 FPS mmap), Next.js 15, Dual-Arch Static Musl (`aarch64` & `armv7l`), MPV GPU, ALSA Direct PCM (`hw:0,0`).
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/vndangkhoa/kv-trimui
- **Overview:** Open-source suite of 18 native & hybrid handheld applications (YouTube, Tidal Hi-Fi, Netflix, Live IPTV, Radio, Cloud ROM Store, Manga/News Readers, AI Voice Companion) across 6 OS distributions (Stock OS, SpruceOS, Knulli, NextUI, NXRedux, GammaOS).

### 2. VietC (Viet+) — Native Rust Linux Vietnamese IME
- **Tech:** Rust 1.85+, Wayland (`wtype`), X11, Linux `/dev/uinput`.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/vndangkhoa/vietc
- **Overview:** High-performance native Vietnamese input method engine for Linux in pure Rust (<10MB RAM rootless daemon) with zero pre-edit underline flashing and intelligent English keyword auto-restore.

### 3. KV Synology Community Package Center (`syno.vndns.net`)
- **Role:** Creator & Architect
- **Tech:** Python (Flask), PostgreSQL, Docker, GnuPG (GPG), Synology SPK architecture.
- **Overview:** Independent community package repository server integrating directly into Synology DSM Package Center with cryptographic GPG package verification and 1-click installation.

### 4. kv-synology (DSM Web Manager & AI MCP Hub)
- **Tech:** Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Synology API, Docker.
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/vndangkhoa/kv-synology
- **Overview:** Modern DSM management dashboard featuring QuickConnect resolver with relay fallback, service management (SMB, NFS, SSH, WebDAV), system telemetry, and a suite of 42 AI MCP tools allowing autonomous LLM agents to monitor and control NAS operations.

### 5. kv-file-pro & ola (Cryptographic Sandboxing & Forensic Anti-Leak DRM)
- **Tech:** Rust (Axum), Go, Argon2id, RFC 6238 TOTP 2FA, Ed25519 asymmetric offline licensing, SQLite WAL.
- **Overview:** Enterprise-grade file management and forensic watermarking suite with dynamic screen-recording/DevTools traps.

### 6. KV-Tube (Media Streaming Platform)
- **Tech:** Go (Gin), Next.js, HLS adaptive bitrate streaming, Docker.
- **Overview:** End-to-end self-hosted video sharing platform featuring segmented adaptive streaming and automated transcoding.
